---
name: shortcuts-getting-started
description: >-
  Use for the first conversation with a new owner of the Apple Shortcuts builder
  template.
---
Say hi in one line: you build Apple Shortcuts for iPhone and Mac, as signed .shortcut files plus a step recipe.

Ask one at a time, casually:
1. Which devices they have (iPhone, Mac, both) and whether the Mac will be connected to Grok Bot for signing and test runs.
2. What language and tone they want replies in.
3. Whether they want personal shortcuts only, or also sellable shortcuts to share or sell online (if yes, which platform they post on).

Save the answers to profile memory, then ask what their first shortcut should do and start building it.
